dz: 美国总统林登·B·约翰逊 (Lyndon B. Johnson) 将一项反垄断豁免签署成为法律，允许国家橄榄球联盟 (National Football League) 与新兴的美国橄榄球联盟 (American Football League) 合并。
de: U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson signs into law an antitrust exemption allowing the National Football League to merge with the upstart American Football League.

t: 前马萨诸塞州总检察长爱德华·布鲁克成为自重建以来第一位当选美国参议院的非裔美国人。
te: Former Massachusetts Attorney General Edward Brooke becomes the first African American elected to the United States Sen…
dz: 前马萨诸塞州总检察长爱德华·布鲁克成为自重建以来第一位当选美国参议院的非裔美国人。
de: Former Massachusetts Attorney General Edward Brooke becomes the first African American elected to the United States Senate since Reconstruction.

t: NASA 发射双子座 12 号。
te: NASA launches Gemini 12.
dz: NASA 发射双子座 12 号。
de: NASA launches Gemini 12.

t: 日本航空533号班机全部坠入日本松山机场附近的濑户内地海,造成50人死亡.
te: All Nippon Airways Flight 533 crashes into the Seto Inland Sea near Matsuyama Airport in Japan, killing 50 people.
dz: 日本航空533号班机全部坠入日本松山机场附近的濑户内地海,造成50人死亡.
de: All Nippon Airways Flight 533 crashes into the Seto Inland Sea near Matsuyama Airport in Japan, killing 50 people.

dz: 针对法塔赫在西岸边界附近对以色列人的袭击,以色列向As-Samu村发动了袭击.
de: In response to Fatah raids against Israelis near the West Bank border, Israel launches an attack on the village of As-Samu.

t: 双子座12号完成方案的最后任务,当它安全地在大西洋上溅下.
te: Gemini 12 completes the program's final mission, when it splashes down safely in the Atlantic Ocean.
dz: 双子座计划:双子座12号完成方案的最后任务,当它安全地在大西洋上溅下.
de: Project Gemini: Gemini 12 completes the program's final mission, when it splashes down safely in the Atlantic Ocean.

dz: The Temptations发行了他们的"最伟大的Hits"专辑,这更是1967年的"Billboard Year-End R&B"专辑.
de: The Temptations release their Greatest Hits album, which goes on to be the Billboard Year-End R&B album of 1967.

t: 保加利亚TABSO101航班在捷克斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发附近坠毁,机上82人全部遇难.
te: Bulgarian TABSO Flight 101 crashes near Bratislava, Czechoslovakia, killing all 82 people on board.
dz: 保加利亚TABSO101航班在捷克斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发附近坠毁,机上82人全部遇难.
de: Bulgarian TABSO Flight 101 crashes near Bratislava, Czechoslovakia, killing all 82 people on board.

t: 米歇尔·米康贝罗推翻了布隆迪的君主制,并让自己成为了第一任总统.
te: Michel Micombero overthrows the monarchy of Burundi and makes himself the first president.
dz: 米歇尔·米康贝罗推翻了布隆迪的君主制,并让自己成为了第一任总统.
de: Michel Micombero overthrows the monarchy of Burundi and makes himself the first president.

t: 非殖民化:巴巴多斯从联合王国独立.
te: Barbados becomes independent from the United Kingdom.
dz: 非殖民化:巴巴多斯从联合王国独立.
de: Decolonization: Barbados becomes independent from the United Kingdom.

t: 希腊的SS Heraklion号舰在爱琴海遭遇风暴而下沉,造成200多人死亡.
te: The Greek ship SS Heraklion sinks in a storm in the Aegean Sea, killing over 200.
dz: 希腊的SS Heraklion号舰在爱琴海遭遇风暴而下沉,造成200多人死亡.
de: The Greek ship SS Heraklion sinks in a storm in the Aegean Sea, killing over 200.

te: Saturn's moon Epimetheus is discovered by astronomer Richard Walker.
dz: 由天文学家理查德·沃克(Richard Walker)发现了土星的月球"伊庇米修斯".
de: Saturn's moon Epimetheus is discovered by astronomer Richard Walker.

t: 美国军方包租的Canadair CL-44坠入了南越的一个小村庄,造成111人死亡.
te: A Canadair CL-44 chartered by the United States military crashes into a small village in South Vietnam, killing 111.
dz: 美国军方包租的Canadair CL-44坠入了南越的一个小村庄,造成111人死亡.
de: A Canadair CL-44 chartered by the United States military crashes into a small village in South Vietnam, killing 111.

de: The first Kwanzaa is celebrated by Maulana Karenga, the chair of Black Studies at California State University, Long Beach.

t: 燕子洞(英语:Cave of Swallows)是世界上已知最大的洞穴井,出土于墨西哥圣路易斯…
te: The Cave of Swallows, the largest known cave shaft in the world, is discovered in Aquismón, San Luis Potosí, Mexico.
dz: 燕子洞(英语:Cave of Swallows)是世界上已知最大的洞穴井,出土于墨西哥圣路易斯波多西的Aquismón.
de: The Cave of Swallows, the largest known cave shaft in the world, is discovered in Aquismón, San Luis Potosí, Mexico.
